item.description:
Antigravity connection repair

Fixes Gemini connections when Antigravity's standalone desktop account service uses local HTTP without extension-server flags. SubFuse now tries HTTPS followed by HTTP only on verified listening ports owned by the running Antigravity process.

Account checks, loopback-only requests, runtime-token handling, and saved readings remain protected. No Google sign-in credentials are imported.

Live-tested with Antigravity 2.28.2 and a Starter Quota account: adding Gemini, matching both allowance pools to Antigravity, refreshing, and refreshing again after restarting SubFuse. Other plans and versions remain unverified.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. This beta is ad hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.
